description: This PHP script handles user session validation, initializes CSRF protection, processes form input to determine report type and time frame, and facilitates secure download of a generated parental report file. It includes functions for file downloading with support for range requests and outputs necessary headers for file transfer.

classes.name: csrfprotector_rdkb
classes.description: A class responsible for CSRF protection initialization, included from external CSRF library.

methods.name: file_download
methods.description: Handles the streaming of a file to the client, managing headers, range requests, and output buffering.
